title: Lining.
officialText: The inside of the interior wall shall be lined with an approved high-duty refractory brick, a minimum of 41/2 inches (114 mm) thick laid on the 41/2-inch bed (114 mm) in an approved high-duty refractory mortar. The lining shall start at the base of the chimney and extend continuously to the top.
